## Checklist

- [ ] This isn't a language-definition change (those belong upstream in
      [github-linguist](https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist) — they
      sync here automatically; `definitions/*.yml` is machine-written)
- [ ] `bash tests/pull-samples.sh` was run, and `cargo test` passes locally
- [ ] No version bump or tag included (the maintainer handles releases)
